content.title: Rotting Oranges
content.description: You are given an m x n grid where each cell can have one of three values: 0 representing an empty cell, 1 representing a fresh orange, or 2 representing a rotten orange. Every minute, any fresh orange that is 4-directionally adjacent to a rotten orange becomes rotten. Return the minimum number of minutes that must elapse until no cell has a fresh orange. If this is impossible, return -1.

examples.explanation: The orange in the bottom left corner (row 2, column 0) is never rotten, because rotting only happens 4-directionally.
Since there are already no fresh oranges at minute 0, the answer is 0.

hints: Think of this as a multi-source BFS problem
Start BFS from all initially rotten oranges simultaneously
How do you track the time/level in BFS?
What if some fresh oranges are unreachable?
edge_cases: Fresh oranges unreachable from any rotten orange
follow_up_questions: How would you modify this for 8-directional spread?
What if different oranges had different rotting speeds?
How would you track the actual path of infection?
